actions.description: The Project Management Plan soundly integrates the subsidiary management plans (Scope, Risk, Quality, Communications, Resource, etc.), establishes valid baselines, and defines clear governance rules -- approve it to authorize drafting ADRs, BRDs, FDDs, and User Stories
The Project Management Plan has critical gaps, conflicting subsidiary plans, or ungrounded baseline assumptions -- reject it outright
The Project Management Plan requires reconciliation among subsidiary plans, clearer risk/quality thresholds, or unforced schedule/cost deferrals before authorization

metadata.decision_context: Formal governance validation gate for the integrated Project Management Plan (PMP) and subsidiary baselines

complexity_profile.rationale: Reused directly from sidpa-template's own shared-complexity-profile.json, which itself was corrected from a real ADPA mistake (approve-adr was first built with requires_human_approval: false, and the resolver's own execute_without_confirmation logic would have bypassed a real governance rule as a result). Correct this down per-policy only with real evidence the specific decision doesn't need a human sign-off -- never flip it the other direction speculatively.
